

```{python}
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

# --- 1. THE RESIDUAL BLOCK (ResNet) ---
class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super(ResidualBlock, self).__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x  # Save the input for the shortcut
        
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        
        # THE MAGIC STEP: Add the input back to the output
        out += identity 
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


```


```{python}

# --- 2. THE PLAIN BLOCK (Standard CNN) ---
class PlainBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super(PlainBlock, self).__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)

    def forward(self, x):
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        
        # NO SHORTCUT: Just return the transformed data
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


```


```{python}

# Example usage:
input_tensor = torch.randn(1, 64, 32, 32) # (Batch, Channels, Height, Width)
resnet_layer = ResidualBlock(64, 64)
plain_layer = PlainBlock(64, 64)

print(f"ResNet Output Shape: {resnet_layer(input_tensor).shape}")
```
